description: Cross-engine parity for the playback frame-cache eviction victim selection. The native cache (src-tauri/src/monitor/frame_cache.rs `VideoFrameCache::evict`) and the web cache (src/utils/video-editor/compositor/VideoFrameCache.ts `findEvictionCandidate`) both evict the cached frame FARTHEST from the current playhead/priority point — the scrub-locality heuristic. The two engines key frames in different units (native = PTS rounded to ms; web = timeline time in us), but the victim-pick logic is unit-neutral: argmax of |tick - request|, ties broken toward the LARGER tick. These cases are therefore expressed in abstract integer ticks and fed to `choose_eviction_victim` (native) / `chooseEvictionVictimTime` (web) verbatim.

cases.name: single frame is always the victim
playhead at the end evicts the oldest (farthest behind)
playhead at the start evicts the newest (farthest ahead)
asymmetric: a distant future frame beats nearer past frames
playhead beyond all frames evicts the farthest behind
equidistant tie resolves to the larger tick
centered playhead with a lopsided range evicts the farthest end
symmetric tie around the playhead resolves to the larger tick
